# Request the Pipe & Drum Corps

## The Pipe & Drum Corps

The unit provides public appreciation and support to formal ceremonies of the Sheriff’s Office and throughout the local community. The unit presents musical tradition and honor at Police and/or Fire Department procession services, as well as in parades and other special events involving the Sheriff’s Office.

The Corps is under the supervision of the Court Services Divisions. Tracing their tradition to Scottish heritage, this group of officers uses personal time to perfect their art and engage in community activities.

Requests for the Pipe & Drum Corps should be emailed to **dbrogan@hcso.org**. We ask that you please submit a request at least three weeks in advance, unless it’s an emergency.
